start.du_kannst_die_sprache: You can change the language at any time: via the globe chip at the top or in your profile under “Language”. The app switches instantly and your data stays as it is.
start.erkennungsmelodie_und_kurze_erfolg: Signature tune and short success sounds
onboarding.wir_passen_kalorien_rezepte: We adapt calories, recipes and tips to you. You can change your goal at any time.
onboarding.sanftes_kaloriendefizit_fett_: Gentle calorie deficit: lose fat while keeping your energy.
onboarding.gesund_aufbauen_fur_alle: Build up healthily: for anyone who is too light and wants to gain strength.
onboarding.balance_finden_gewicht_stabil: Find balance: keep your weight stable and age fit.
onboarding2.grosse_alter_und_geschlecht: We need height, date of birth (for your age) and sex for your BMI, body-fat reference values and your calorie needs. Your data stays private.
onboarding3.wahle_dein_ziel_und: Choose your goal and how fast you want to reach it. Slow and steady is usually better and lasts longer.
onboarding4.was_isst_du_gern: What do you like to eat?
onboarding4.allergien_unvertraglichkeite: We take allergies, intolerances and preferences into account for recipes and the shopping list. You can change everything later in your profile.
daten.diese_angaben_dienen_nur: This data is only used for BMI, reference values and calorie needs, and stays private.
details.optional_du_entscheidest_ob: Optional. You decide whether you want to use an eating window.
erfassen.tippen_oder_sprechen_wahle: Type or speak. Pick a suggestion and the portion.
erfassen.halte_die_kamera_uber: Hold the camera over your food. The AI recognises dishes, portion and calories. This feature comes after version 1.
erfassen.ein_tipp_und_die: One tap and the meal is logged.
erfassen.halte_den_barcode_ins: Hold the barcode in the frame …
erfassen.gerichte_portionen_und_kalorien: Dishes, portions and calories are being estimated.
rezepte.gut_bewertete_rezepte_schlagen: We suggest well-rated recipes more often, with variety from around the world. Rate with stars and save your favourites.
rezepte.eine_handvoll_nusse_am: A handful of nuts in the afternoon keeps you full for longer.
rezepte.prototyp_bei_allergien_prufe: Prototype: if you have allergies, always check the ingredient list on the packaging.
einkauf.antippen_liegt_im_korb: Tap = in the basket (crossed out, moves down).
einkauf.hab_ich_schon_zu: “Got it” = all or part already at home; the amount to buy is adjusted.
einkauf.spater_laden_wahlen_z: Later: choose your shops (e.g. Migros, Coop, Lidl, Aldi) and get recipes matching their deals. Marked when a loyalty card or app is needed, e.g. “card only”.
einkauf.prototyp_teilen_ist_hier: Prototype: sharing is only simulated here.
restaurant.tipp_sauce_und_dressing: Tip: order sauce and dressing on the side.
woche.wasserziel_an_5_von: Water goal reached on 5 of 7 days
woche.wir_gehen_nie_unter: We never go below the minimum of 1,200 kcal (women) or 1,500 kcal (men).
kraft.kraft_erhalt_muskeln_und: Strength preserves muscles and bones and keeps you mobile into old age.
fortschritt.dein_weg_zu_mehr: Your path to more energy and health
fortschritt.der_bmi_ist_nur: BMI is only a rough guide. With a lot of muscle it shows values that are too high; body fat and muscle share say more.
fortschritt.sobald_deine_smart_waage: As soon as your smart scale measures body fat, you will see your trend here and reference values for your age and sex.
fortschritt.privat_und_ende_zu: Private and end-to-end encrypted: only you can see your photos.
koerper.ein_steigender_muskelanteil_ist: A rising muscle share is a good sign, even if your weight barely drops.
koerper.wichtiger_als_das_gewicht: More important than weight: keep muscle, lower body fat. Scale values are estimates.
koerper.verbinde_eine_smart_waage: Connect a smart scale with body analysis, then body fat and muscle mass appear here.
profil.mit_erkennungsmelodie_wenn_tone: With signature tune when sounds are on
profil.zusammensetzen_herzschlag_auflose: Assemble, heartbeat, dissolve. Tap to stop.
profil.edovita_klick_prototyp_v5: Edovita · click prototype v5.10, no real data
erinnerungen.sanfte_erinnerungen_ohne_dr: Gentle reminders, no pressure. You decide which ones you get.
erinnerungen.so_sieht_eine_benachrichtig: This is what a notification looks like
erinnerungen.du_hast_heute_750: You have drunk 750 of 2,250 ml today.
erinnerungen.tippe_auf_eine_art: Tap a type to see an example at the top of the screen:
erinnerungen.prototyp_es_werden_keine: Prototype: no real notifications are sent.
hilfe.wenn_essen_gewicht_oder: If food, weight or your body weigh heavily on you, talking can help. These services are free and confidential.
hilfe.rund_um_die_uhr: Around the clock, anonymous and free. Chat daily 10 am to 10 pm and mail at 143.ch.
hilfe.kostenlose_anonyme_beratung_bei: Free, anonymous counselling for eating problems, eating disorders and fitness or muscle addiction, also for relatives. Phone usually Monday and Thursday. pepinfo.ch
hilfe.beratung_in_zurich_per: Counselling in Zurich by phone, email, in person or by video, free of charge. Phone Tuesday and Thursday, 10–12 and 14–17. aes.ch
hilfe.sanitat_144_oder_notruf: Ambulance 144 or emergency number 112. For children and young people: Pro Juventute, phone 147.
hilfe.angaben_am_4_november: Details checked on the providers' websites on 4 November 2026. Edovita does not replace medical or therapeutic advice. Feel free to talk to your GP as well.
partner.sam_kocht_und_sieht: Sam cooks and sees what fits your day. You decide below what Sam can see.
partner.damit_sam_passend_kochen: So Sam can cook to match
partner.gultig_10_minuten_dein: Valid for 10 minutes. Your partner enters the code in their app.
partner.du_schickst_einen_einladungslink: You send an invitation link via WhatsApp. It is valid for 24 hours and can only be used once.
partner.prototyp_hier_wurde_whatsapp: Prototype: WhatsApp would open here with the link.
partner.fur_die_verbindung_braucht: The connection needs a small server (EU). Shared data is transmitted encrypted. You can disconnect at any time.
partner.prototyp_verbindung_wurde_nach: Prototype: the connection would be removed after a confirmation.
arzt.das_pdf_wird_nur: The PDF is created only on your device. You decide who receives it.
arzt.prototyp_es_wird_keine: Prototype: no real file is created.
sprache.gilt_fur_menus_hinweise: Applies to menus, notices, recipes and legal texts.
sprache.wann_kann_ich_die: When can I change the language?
sprache.jederzeit_auch_mitten_im: At any time, even in the middle of onboarding. The app switches instantly without a restart. Your goals, meals, ratings and settings stay unchanged; only the display changes.
sprache.zahlen_und_datum_folgen: Numbers and dates follow the language. Weight stays in kg, energy in kcal.
sprache.ausgegraute_sprachen_sind_nicht: Greyed-out languages cannot be selected. A language is only unlocked once the translation and legal texts have been reviewed.
toene.ki_generiert_mit_ace: AI-generated with ACE-Step v1 (Apache-2.0). H1 and H5 are the favourites, H4 the reserve. It plays with the start animation.
toene.tone_spielen_nur_nach: Sounds only play after a tap and never when sound is off. On the very first start the browser does not allow sound yet.
datenschutz.deine_daten_bleiben_auf: Your data stays on your device
datenschutz.gewicht_mahlzeiten_und_ziele: Weight, meals and goals are health data. Edovita stores them only locally on your phone. No account, no ads, no analysis of your health data.
datenschutz.bevor_du_das_backup: Before you turn on the backup
datenschutz.deine_daten_werden_auf: Your data is encrypted on your device (end-to-end) and only then stored, in the EU with Cloudflare. Nobody but you can read it, not even us. You can turn the backup off and delete it at any time.
datenschutz.ich_willige_ausdrucklich_ein: I explicitly consent to my health data being backed up in encrypted form.
datenschutz.als_datei_z_b: As a file, e.g. when changing devices
datenschutz.prototyp_hier_wurde_nach: Prototype: everything would be deleted here after a confirmation.
datenschutz.dieser_prototyp_merkt_sich: This prototype stores language, second language, display, sound, meal plan and shopping list on this device only. Body data are sample values. The export contains only the meal plan and shopping list, no health data.
doc.title: Edovita – {screen}
risk.help: If food or your body weighs heavily on you, a confidential conversation helps.
risk.verylow.title: Your BMI is very low
risk.verylow.gain: Gaining weight is the right goal for you. At such a low weight, though, the build-up should be medically supervised: please talk to your GP and, if possible, a nutrition counsellor. Especially at the start your body needs a slow, protected beginning. You are not alone in this.
risk.verylow.keep: Please talk to your GP and, if possible, a nutrition counsellor. We recommend not letting your weight drop further and gaining healthily. We are happy to switch your goal to “Gain weight”.
risk.verylow.other: At this value losing weight is not sensible, so we do not offer a calorie deficit. We recommend maintaining your weight or gaining healthily. Please talk to your GP and, if possible, a nutrition counsellor.
risk.low.title: Your BMI is below the normal range
risk.low.gain: Gaining weight fits your goal. A medical check-up and nutrition counselling help you build up safely and sustainably. If food or your body weighs on you, free and confidential help is available.
risk.low.keep: We recommend maintaining your weight or gaining healthily. A nutrition counsellor or your GP can support you. If food weighs on you, free and confidential help is available.
risk.low.other: We recommend maintaining or gaining healthily and hide weight loss. If food weighs on you, free and confidential help is available.
risk.highgain.title: Your BMI is above the normal range
risk.highgain.text: More weight is usually not advisable at your BMI. If you want to build muscle, “Maintain weight” with strength training is often a better fit. Your GP can help with questions.
risk.ambitious.title: Your goal is very ambitious
risk.ambitious.text: A calmer pace or a slightly higher target weight is healthier and lasts longer. If food, weight or body shape occupy you a lot, a conversation can help.
fat.hint: Reference values for {sex}, {age} years. They are a guide, not a diagnosis.
chart.w.aria: Weight trend with BMI bands: currently {w} kilograms, BMI {b}
chart.f.aria: Body-fat trend in percent with reference values for {sex}, {age} years: currently {v} percent
chart.m.aria: Muscle mass in percent over time: currently {v} percent
sum.kcal: Calorie needs approx. {need} kcal per day. Your daily goal: {goal} kcal ({goalname}, {mode}).
sum.note: BMI is only a rough guide, e.g. with a lot of muscle mass.
pace.keep.title: Maintain weight
pace.keep.text: You don't need a pace here. We adjust your calories so that your weight stays stable.
pace.weeks: {n, plural, one {In about # week at a steady pace.} other {In about # weeks at a steady pace.}}
pace.sus.title: Edovita chooses your pace
pace.sus.lose: About 0.5 % of your body weight per week. We take the last 2 kg even more slowly, then 4 weeks of stabilising follow{until}. This keeps the result and makes the yo-yo effect less likely.
pace.sus.gain: About 0.25 kg per week: this builds mainly muscle instead of fat. Afterwards we stabilise your weight.
pace.limited.title: Pace was limited
pace.limited.text: Your daily goal would fall below {floor} kcal. We never go below that, so we calculate with {r} kg per week.
pace.adj.title: Adjust target weight
pace.adj.lose: Your target weight is not below your current weight. Choose a lower goal.
pace.adj.gain: Your target weight is not above your current weight. Choose a higher goal.
pace.lownormal: Note: your goal is in the lower normal range. We do not offer goals below BMI {b} ({kg} kg).
pace.min: For safety reasons we do not offer target weights below BMI 18.5 ({kg} kg).
v.bad.title: Too fast, we don't recommend this
v.warn.title: Ambitious
v.ok.title: Very doable
v.lose.bad: At this pace you lose muscle more easily, have more cravings and the yo-yo risk rises. At most {max} kg per week is recommended. Sustainable would be approx. {sus} kg.
v.lose.warn: This is doable but takes discipline. Plan in recovery and enough protein.
v.lose.ok: A calm pace protects your muscles and makes the result last longer.
v.gain.bad: Gaining quickly usually builds more fat than muscle. At most 0.5 kg per week is recommended.
v.gain.warn: With strength training and plenty of protein this is possible.
pref.note: If you have allergies, always check the ingredient list on the packaging. This prototype gives no guarantee.
recipe.none.title: No matching recipes
recipe.none.text: With your details and these filters there is no recipe right now. Choose other filters or adjust your preferences.
recipe.info.hidden: {n, plural, one {# recipe hidden.} other {# recipes hidden.}}
recipe.info.hint: Enter them and we will only show suitable recipes. Tap here.
recipe.rated.toast: Thanks! We'll suggest similar dishes more often.

rest.sub.gain: Based on your open {n} kcal and your protein goal

adapt.gain.title: Daily goal reached
adapt.gain.text: You've reached your calorie goal for today, which is exactly right for gaining weight. Your goal stays unchanged.
adapt.title: A bit more today, that's okay
adapt.over: You are {n} kcal above your daily goal.
adapt.spread: We'll gently adjust the next 3 days: {per} kcal less each.
adapt.spread.rest: We'll gently adjust the next 3 days: {per} kcal less each, and balance the rest over the week.
adapt.keep: We'll keep your goal unchanged and balance it over the week.
water.left: {n} ml to go to your daily goal.
week.lose.three: You hit your calorie goal on 6 of 7 days, great! Your protein averaged 82 g; the goal is 110 g. More vegetables in the evening would support your energy and your weight.
week.keep.three: You hit your calorie goal on 6 of 7 days, great! Your protein averaged 82 g; the goal is 110 g. More vegetables in the evening would support your energy.
week.gain.three: You reached your calorie goal on 6 of 7 days, great! Your protein averaged 82 g; the goal is 110 g. An extra protein-rich meal in the evening would support your build-up.
week.lose.adapt: On Wednesday you were 180 kcal above your daily goal. That's completely normal. We spread it gently: Thursday to Saturday 60 kcal less each. This keeps your weekly goal the same.
week.keep.adapt: On Wednesday you were 180 kcal above your daily goal. That's completely normal. We spread it gently: Thursday to Saturday 60 kcal less each. This keeps your weight stable.
week.gain.adapt: On Wednesday you were 180 kcal above your daily goal. For gaining weight that's fine; we keep your goal unchanged. If you ever lack appetite, we balance it gently over the following days.
week.gain.better: Plan an energy-rich snack, e.g. nuts or yoghurt

kcal.low.title: Only with medical supervision
kcal.low.text: This goal is below {safe} kcal. For you, it is only suitable with medical supervision.
kcal.low.more1: Without supervision, the guideline is at least {floor} kcal per day and not less than your basal metabolic rate (estimated approx. {bmr} kcal).
kcal.low.more2: Very little energy can lead to muscle loss, nutrient deficiencies, gallstones, dizziness and the yo-yo effect. Not suitable during pregnancy or breastfeeding, under 18, or with a (past) eating disorder.
kcal.low.more3: Edovita does not give medical advice. Discuss this goal with your doctor and have regular check-ups.
kcal.low.confirm: I am under medical supervision for this.
kcal.low.pending: Until you confirm, Edovita uses {safe} kcal.
kcal.hard: {min} kcal is the lower limit in Edovita. It cannot go lower, even with confirmation.

kcal.lose.none: To lose weight, the goal should be below your need of approx. {need} kcal.
kcal.gain.none.title: You won't gain weight like this
kcal.gain.none: To gain weight, the goal should be above your need of approx. {need} kcal.
kcal.gain.more: About 250 to 500 kcal above your need is sensible, with enough protein and strength training. If you are underweight or losing weight unintentionally, please see a doctor.
kcal.keep.title: Maintain weight
kcal.keep.text: Your need is approx. {need} kcal per day. Close to that, your weight stays stable.

kcal.keep.more.gain: With this goal you would gain about {r} kg per week. Otherwise choose the goal “{goal}”.
